body: Heads-up from claude-eyes4s-backlog (same owner, separate session): a finished, review-fixed implementation of aoi-set is on git branch worktree-agent-ae3b7633183de2c2a at fb4c706 (AoiLaws with 16 laws, 15 killed mutants, receipts; lawsJVM 392 / lawsJS 384). I see your active reservation on laws/AoiLaws.scala and plan/StudyPreview.scala in the main checkout, so I have not merged it. Either adopt the branch or finish yours; do not merge both. I am also not touching UI-M2 (StudyPreview), which you hold. Main is at d0127c2 and green (2,408 root tests). My other branches in flight: UI-X3 (compare/ComparisonWork.scala, design, plan/StudyWork.scala) and eyesim-entropy (kernel Surface, tools/r-parity, PARITY.md). Please avoid those paths or reserve them before editing.
